domains.name: Product Master Data
domains.description: Information about SKUs, including price and tax class, sourced from SAP S/4HANA.

domains.name: Order Data
domains.description: Customer orders placed through Shopify, processed in SAP, and related events from payment providers.

domains.name: Inventory Data
domains.description: Stock levels and availability across warehouses and stores, sourced from SAP S/4HANA and Nordkap Logistics.

domains.name: Customer Data
domains.description: Customer profiles and related service interactions from Shopify Plus and Salesforce Service Cloud.

domains.name: Logistics Data
domains.description: Dispatch, tracking, and shipment confirmations from the third-party logistics provider, Nordkap Logistics.

domains.name: Financial Settlement Data
domains.description: Daily settlement files from payment providers for reconciliation and posting to SAP S/4HANA.

domains.name: Integration Operational Data
domains.description: Message payloads and reconciliation results generated and managed by the integration platform.

ingestion.text: Data ingestion handles diverse formats and frequencies, from near-real-time API calls for orders and inventory updates to batch file transfers for logistics and financial settlements. The API Gateway and Enterprise Service Bus manage inbound API traffic and message queuing, while SFTP File Storage and Integration handles file-based data. Integration Microservices Execution processes these incoming data streams, ensuring high throughput and low latency as required by critical business operations.

transactional_storage.text: Transactional storage, provided by the Operational & Reconciliation Database, is used to persist message payloads and reconciliation results. This enables robust retry mechanisms with backoff and dead-letter destinations for failed messages. This database supports the operational needs of the integration platform, ensuring data integrity and traceability for ongoing processes.

analytical_storage.text: Analytical storage leverages the existing Snowflake data warehouse for comprehensive reporting and operational dashboards. Customer and order data are sent nightly, complemented by an intraday order-events feed. Integration Microservices Execution facilitates these data transfers, supporting the customer's analytical and reporting needs.

quality.validation_reason: Specific data quality rules and validation thresholds require further definition.
quality.text: Data quality is maintained through validation and transformation steps within the Integration Microservices Execution. This ensures that data, particularly for inventory and product master, is consistent and valid before being propagated to target systems. Specific data quality rules and validation thresholds require further definition and validation.

metadata_governance.validation_reason: Specific governance tools and processes require definition.
metadata_governance.text: Metadata and governance involve capturing information about data flows, transformations, and retention policies. This supports compliance with regulations like GDPR for personal data and ensures traceability of integration processes. The Web Management Portal can expose this metadata, while the Operational & Reconciliation Database stores the underlying information.

retention.text: Data retention policies are applied to integration-specific data. Message payloads are retained for 90 days to support operational troubleshooting and auditing. Reconciliation results are retained for 7 years to meet compliance requirements. The Operational & Reconciliation Database manages these retention periods, with automated processes for data lifecycle management.

privacy_security.validation_reason: Assumption ASM_02 regarding standard security practices is pending confirmation.
privacy_security.text: Privacy and security measures ensure GDPR compliance for personal data within order flows, with PCI compliance explicitly out of scope. Data is protected using standard security practices, including encryption via Key Management Service and access controls managed by the Identity Provider. Network isolation is provided by the Virtual Network, aligning with assumed security best practices.

reporting_analytics.text: Reporting and analytics capabilities are primarily supported by the existing Snowflake data warehouse, which receives customer and order data nightly and an intraday feed of order events. An Observability Dashboard provides operational insights into the integration platform itself, with monitoring data feeding into the customer's existing Grafana instance.

backup_recovery.validation_reason: Specific Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) for the integration platform's data require further definition.
backup_recovery.text: Backup and recovery mechanisms are essential for all critical data managed by the integration platform, particularly the Operational & Reconciliation Database. An Automated Backup Service will ensure regular backups are taken and stored securely. Specific Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) for the integration platform's data require further definition.
